custom_steps:
1. In the Customer filter, tick customer A and customer B.
  2. In the Past due filter, tick "91+ days".
  3. Reload the page.
  4. In the Past due filter, untick "91+ days".
  5. In the Past due filter, tick "91+ days" again. Open Sales By Customer (Reports, then "Sales By Customer" under PERFORMANCE in the left menu), then click the browser's Back button. (QA lead ruling, 11 Nov 2026: Back restores the filters when it brings you back to the report, as on Sales By Customer; Back straight after a filter change leaves the report.)
